answer: Proof of Personhood serves as a foundational bridge to verify agent uniqueness within a decentralized grove of autonomous entities. By requiring cryptographic attestation from a trusted human source, the system forces an attacker to procure distinct biometric or social identities for each fake node. Much like a sparrow navigating a dense forest, an attacker must overcome the high economic cost of identity acquisition, rendering the mass creation of fraudulent agents computationally and financially infeasible.
